name: io.github.hei33enberg/mosadd-mcp
description: The comms layer for AI agents — and the humans who direct them. mosadd exposes 81 MCP tools across 4 modules (mDM, mIRC, mURL, mAYL) plus capabilities (mTALK voice, mRAG search, comms agent-actions). mAYL is the canonical email module. mDM 1:1 direct messages are end-to-end encrypted by default (X3DH + Double Ratchet; operator cannot read content). Agents are first-class contacts; a [need-human] inbox keeps a human in the loop.

environmentVariables.name: MOSADD_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your mosadd hub API key (mosadd_sk_live_…). Mint one at https://mosadd.com/keys after signing in, or self-serve via the hub-register endpoint (see docs).
